title: Security test matrix and packaged-binary qualification on macOS
description: Spec §14 and §15. docs/security-tests.md maps every gate to a test and result; packaged binary smoke-tested against the real Keychain; standalone workflow without Lore/Quest; separate reviewer pass over crypto, error paths, authority checks and the keychain boundary.

acceptanceCriteria.text: T23: the full P0 workflow works with neither Lore nor Quest installed
T26: real key-provider integration and packaged-binary smoke tests pass on macOS; mocked unit tests are not counted
T05 (full): database, journals, sidecars, temp paths and backups are free of synthetic plaintext after every command path

implementationNotes: Release-gate obligation recorded 2026-09-29 (DEC-50, ADR 0018, WCLI-38). The profileSnapshotVersion decision this record already points at is made: the constant stays 1 while Ward is unreleased, and the commit that cuts the first release bumps it and updates the comment in src/domain/profile.ts, so the released build refuses every dev-era snapshot with no migration. The obligation is now step 1 of docs/runbooks/cutting-a-ward-release.md, so whoever cuts the release meets it without rediscovering WCLI-38. When this task writes docs/security-tests.md, the release-gate row for the bump belongs in it.

opum-doc ruling DEC-217 (a2) (opum-ai/opum-doc#1165), relayed by the leader: WCLI-15 is approved work. Order: non-binary first (T05 plaintext sweep after every command path; T23 without Lore or Quest on PATH; T24 check of what the evals discharge; every matrix row including ADR 0018 profileSnapshotVersion gate), then T26. T26 is option A: scripts/build.ts takes a compile-time service define and produces dist/ward-qualify with service opum.ward.qualify-<random>; the shipped binary gains no runtime override; diff the two builds to show the service constant is the only difference. Isolation proof WITHOUT reading the real opum.ward item (not even metadata): ~/.ward tree digest before and after with HOME set to a temp dir, the build diff, the qualify binary embedded service name, and a trap deleting the probe item from the qualify service. test/qualification/keychain-roundtrip.ts moves off the real opum.ward service. DEC-182: Sonnet authors, opum-doc reviews each PR with Opus by ref; bring PRs up to date by merging dev.

opum-doc verdicts (DEC-217 (a3), reviewer opum-doc, claude-opus-5-5): #156 at 2cc63b41 APPROVE, landed as 6d4f0e2. #157 at 0648255a REQUEST CHANGES, one MEDIUM: pin code run_destination_unresolved in the T26 run (done). LOWs done: parent names and deletes the probe service, probe spawn timeout, signal handlers remove items and the root and take the after-digest, cleanup by service covers every child-created item, verification profile takes ADR 0022 in place of ADR 0005 (stated in the PR). Follow-up from #156 done: T05 tracks command actions via secret and profile vocabularies; T15 other-host case names a listener; T21 names #149. Rulings: T26 network floor is A (no send), a real or loopback-TLS send is a release-gate item (row in docs/security-tests.md); recipe findings accepted. Re-run at the fix head: 21 of 21, a signal-interrupted run also cleaned up.
finalSummary: Landed as opum-ai/ward-cli#156 (6d4f0e2) and #157 (81caf85). AC0 T23: test/standalone.test.ts (no lore or quest on PATH, and failing shims never called, with a positive control) plus the packaged workflow under PATH=/usr/bin:/bin. AC1 T26: dist/ward-qualify with its own opum.ward.qualify-<random> service (no runtime override in the shipped binary), run against a temporary store and the real login keychain via scripts/qualify-packaged.ts, 21 of 21 checks on macOS 27.0.1 and Bun 1.3.14 at 5ca368d, ~/.ward digest unchanged, the real opum.ward item never read, every created item deleted; the key-provider round trip passed. AC2 T05 full: test/disk-exposure.test.ts drives every manifest command path (secret and profile by action) and the failure paths and scans the whole root after each step. docs/security-tests.md maps T01-T26 clause by clause with release-only gates stated (profileSnapshotVersion bump, T24 behavioural halves, T25 federated index, a real send for T26). opum-doc APPROVE on #156 and on #157 after one MEDIUM (pin run_destination_unresolved, fixed) and LOWs, DEC-217 (a2) and (a3). Not done here and recorded as release items: T24 has no automated check-and-run test and the eval run was not repeated; a real or loopback-TLS send is a release gate. Follow-up WCLI-76 (guard deleteService to the qualify prefix).
